candidate.core_job: Evaluate stated robotaxi pilot claims for safety incident reporting, access, empty-mileage and emergency support against local policy recommendations
candidate.target_customer: Municipal transport-policy assessment teams and mobility consultants
candidate.product_mechanism: User-uploaded pilot operator report CSV, permit terms, accessible vehicle count, empty mileage, incident case files and recommendation clause IDs. Rule-based missing-evidence matrix and human signoff; no vehicle data API or permit decision
candidate.why_now: 12 October Register original article based on new 66-page London Assembly Transport Committee report: concerns TfL permit control, wheelchair access, emergency safety and unoccupied vehicle mileage. Recommendations not binding rules; Waymo/Wayve/Baidu future launches not yet permitted by a new regime. City/consultants need document pilot-operator evidence against report recommendations, but no automatic safety certification.
candidate.before_state: Mayor/Transport Committee requests, trial operator reports and policy recommendations are disconnected
candidate.after_state: Traceable evidence gaps, unverified company statements and policy response pack; proposal not yet law
candidate.merge_note: Bu girdi diğer 166 kayıtla müşteri+iş+mekanizma temelinde karşılaştırıldı; doğrudan semantik mükerrer bulunmadı. Rakip/doğrulama hükmü değildir.
candidate.source_evidence_caveat: Kaynak URL'leri ve why_now gözlemleri Discovery'den devralındı. Bu Merge aşaması yeni bir kaynak okuyup page_read kanıtı üretmez.
